Your progress stays in this browser

Career and free-shop saves use local storage. Outfit-photo images use IndexedDB. The game does not upload those saves or photos to a gameplay server. Export/import downloads or reads a file you choose; JSON backups do not contain local outfit-photo binaries.

Export a backup before changing browsers or clearing site data. If you move from the old game address, export there and import here. Hostnames have separate browser storage. Clearing this site's storage deletes local progress and photos.

The hosting provider receives normal web requests. Google Fonts receives requests for the interface fonts; system fonts work if those requests are blocked. Product-reference links open third-party websites with their own policies.
